title: Solid body
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw the first loop which consists of four lines. Start the first line from the origin at coordinates (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0399). Draw the third line from (0.75, 0.0399) to (0.0, 0.0239), and complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0239) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Next, transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the transformed sketch 0.1468 units along the normal direction to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The resulting solid body will have a length of approximately 0.75 units, a width of 0.0399 units, and a height of 0.1468 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the vertices of the sketch
vertices = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0399),
    (0.0, 0.0239)
]

# Create the sketch by adding lines between the vertices
sketch = wp.moveTo(vertices[0][0], vertices[0][1]) \
          .lineTo(vertices[1][0], vertices[1][1]) \
          .lineTo(vertices[2][0], vertices[2][1]) \
          .lineTo(vertices[3][0], vertices[3][1]) \
          .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D shape
r = sketch.extrude(0.1468)

import cadquery as cq

# The part is a long bar (X = 0.75, Z = 0.1468) whose thickness in Y
# tapers along its length: full 0.0399 at the right end, 0.02 at the left end.
# FRONT view shows a plain rectangle (taper is in plan only),
# TOP view shows the sloped edge, RIGHT view shows the full end rectangle.

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0399)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.02)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.1468)
)
